translation:
[Comment] The back folding method: from Dazhui to the coccyx, fold the whole as three chi. The upper seven segments are each one cun, four fen, and one li (釐) long, together nine cun, eight fen, and seven li. The middle seven segments are each one cun, six fen, and one li, together one chi, one cun, two fen, and seven li. The fourteenth segment is level with the navel. The lower seven segments are each one cun, two fen, and six li, together eight cun, eight fen, and two li. Together they are two chi, nine cun, nine fen, and six li; the shortfall of four li is a remainder not exhausted. The straight cun follows this; the horizontal cun uses the middle-finger body-cun (同身寸) method. The spine bone is one cun wide within. Whenever it is said that the second line is one and a half cun beside the spine, and the third line is three cun beside the spine, these all exclude the one cun of the spine, and are discussed purely as one and a half cun and three cun. Therefore in the second line it should be two cun, and in the third line it should be three and a half cun. <ins>Lateral part (側部)</ins>
From the pillar bone (柱骨) descending to where it is not seen in the armpit, it is four cun long.
